profile.title: Profile
profile.desc: Manage your account, theme preference and sessions · Click outside or press Esc to close
profile.communityTitle: This project is published and discussed in the LINUX DO community
profile.aboutDesc: WorkBuddy Manager is an account-pool console and OpenAI-compatible gateway built for workbuddy2api, with QR onboarding for multiple accounts, automatic check-in, key distribution, IP control and usage statistics.
profile.logoutDesc: You will need to enter your username and password again to access the console.
profile.revoked: All sessions revoked — please sign in again
profile.revokeHint: Invalidate every issued sign-in credential server-side (no password change needed)
profile.revokeDesc: Every signed-in session (including this one) is invalidated immediately and you will need to sign in again. Use it when you suspect a credential was captured — e.g. you signed in on someone else's computer, an old device is still signed in, or a backup contains the cookie. It is stronger than Sign out: sign-out only clears this device, revocation voids every credential on the server.

stats.title: Usage
stats.description: Token consumption and request volume by time, model and key (auto-refresh every 60s; currently {realm} only)
stats.repairTitle: Repair usage stats from request logs?
stats.repairDesc: Historical usage that was never counted will be added, using the request logs as the source of truth. The operation is idempotent — running it again never double counts.
stats.nothingToRepairDesc: Stats already match the request logs
stats.rebuildTitle: Rebuild usage stats from request logs?
stats.rebuildDesc: Existing aggregates are cleared and regenerated from the request logs. Use this to clean up double counting caused by inconsistent time zones (the same call counted on two days). Note: if the request logs were cleared before, that history is lost along with them.
stats.upstreamNote: Coming from the upstream itself: includes calls made directly to it, and counts since its process started — independent of the time range above
stats.emptyDesc: No calls for this dimension in the selected range
stats.usageHealthTitle: Usage statistics may not be accumulating
stats.usageHealthDetail: There are {n} requests logged today but usage statistics show 0 — the stats may not be written correctly. Try Repair stats; if it stays at 0, check the server logs.
stats.failedHint: {n} failed today (not counted in the requests above)

accounts.descGlobal: Tencent CodeBuddy account pool (Global edition): token validity and connectivity (auto-refresh every 30s)
accounts.refreshCreditsTitle: Query each account's current credits directly from Tencent (upstream-cached values can lag by hours)
accounts.restartDesc: Normally unnecessary: adding or removing an account reloads upstream automatically. Use this only when upstream is stuck. The restart takes about 0.5s and in-flight requests finish normally.
accounts.emptyDescAdmin: Use Add account in the top right to sign in by QR code
accounts.emptyDescViewer: Ask an administrator to add accounts
accounts.creditsPartial: Some credits could not be fetched

accounts.checkinSkippedNote: (plus {skipped} not applicable — the international realm has no check-in)
accounts.checkinDoneTitle: Already checked in today ({at}) — no need to repeat
accounts.checkinNothingPendingDetail: {n} account(s) already checked in today — come back tomorrow
accounts.checkinAllNoneTitle: Every check-in–eligible account has already checked in today
accounts.checkinAllTitle: {n} account(s) still need to check in today
accounts.taskRunDesc: The same script as the one-click run on the Tasks page, but for this single account. Start with Preview to see what is claimable, then decide.
accounts.taskRunBusyOther: Currently running “{target}” — only one task can run at a time, please wait for it to finish.
accounts.badgeDisabledByPanelTitle: You paused this account here: the upstream will not load it, so it is never selected. Press "Enable" to restore it anytime (credentials are kept).
accounts.badgeManualDisabledTitle: You disabled this account upstream: it will not be picked for traffic, but it stays in the pool — check-in, token keep-alive and other jobs keep running, and its credentials and credits stay live. Click "Enable" on the right to resume at any time.
accounts.disableTitle: Pause this account (never selected upstream; reversible)
accounts.manualDisabled: Account paused (no longer picked for traffic; check-in and keep-alive continue)
accounts.badgeNeverSucceededTitle: This account has been tried {errs} time(s) and never succeeded. The upstream only rotates away from such failures (e.g. a WAF-blocked 403) without cooling the account down, so it looks healthy here while every request actually fails. Consider signing in again or deleting it.
accounts.badgeNotLoadedTitle: This account is not in the upstream pool yet, so the gateway will never pick it. Reload the config on the upstream (Save settings); if it stays this way, check that the account file is complete.
accounts.badgeUnknownTitle: The upstream status is currently unavailable (its container may have just restarted or be temporarily unreachable), so this account's availability cannot be determined. It retries automatically; locally known details (such as token expiry) are still accurate.
accounts.badgeNotLoadedWhy: This account file looks broken: {why}. Sign in again, or delete and re-add the account.
accounts.missingModels: Account lacks these models: {models} (temporarily skipped, no action needed)
accounts.modelLimitTitle: These models are temporarily unavailable (the account is still online; other models work):
accounts.modelMissing: this account does not have this model
accounts.creditsNoneTitle: Upstream has not returned credits for this account yet (recently added, or upstream unreachable)
accounts.snapshotTitle: Snapshot from the upstream /status: the balance recorded when it last scheduled this account. It can lag by hours; click Refresh to query live.
accounts.creditsTitle: Current spendable credit balance (all plans combined)
accounts.cacheTitle: Queried within the last 60 seconds — served from the server cache. Use Refresh credits to force a fresh query.
accounts.liveTitle: Live value just queried from Tencent
accounts.issuedAt: Token issued at {at} (refreshing issues a new token)
accounts.forceClearCoolingTitle: Force-clear this account's cooldown and model limits?
accounts.forceClearCoolingDesc: This restarts the upstream container and clears this account's cooldown, breaker, degradation and model-level rate-limit state. If the root cause remains, the state may return quickly. Credentials and other accounts are not affected.
accounts.deleteDesc: The local authorization file will be deleted and upstream reloaded so it takes effect. This cannot be undone.
accounts.movedTo: Check-in results and upstream task logs moved to
accounts.degradedReason: Temporarily removed from the account pool after {n} consecutive failures; it recovers automatically. If this keeps happening, check whether the account's token has expired (re-login required)
accounts.groupNoDir: Group "{name}" has no local account directory: you can only view accounts here, not add, move or delete them. Set one under Settings → Upstreams (it must match that upstream instance's auths directory).
accounts.moveDesc: Moves the account file to another group. Credentials are not changed; afterwards it only serves keys bound to the target group.
accounts.groupDeleteDesc: Only the group record in this panel is deleted — the account directory and its files stay. Deletion is refused while the group still has accounts or bound keys (the error tells you how many; clear them first).

keys.deleteDesc: Calls made with this key stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
keys.emptyDesc: Create a key to call this gateway from any OpenAI SDK
keys.editDesc: Change the name, pinned edition, IP allowlist, model allowlist and quota
keys.createDesc: The full key is shown only once, right after creation — store it safely
keys.name: Name
keys.ipWhitelist: IP allowlist (one per line, CIDR supported, empty = unrestricted)
keys.modelWhitelist: Model allowlist (comma separated, empty = every model of that edition)

keys.createdButRefreshFailed: Key created, but refreshing the list failed
keys.createdButRefreshFailedHint: Refresh the page to see it
keys.createdDesc: Copy it now — once this dialog closes the full key cannot be shown again
keys.daysRequired: Enter a number of days greater than 0
keys.quotaCreditHint: Accumulated from the real charge reported by the upstream (not estimated from tokens). Independent of the token quota above — exceeding either one blocks calls. Leave 0 for unlimited
keys.modelsUnknown: No model matches these names (possible typo): {names}. They will not be listed and calls using them are rejected.
keys.exportHint: Generates a snippet you can paste into the client's config. Available only once — after closing, the key is stored as a hash and cannot be exported again.
keys.importHintReady: Writes straight into this machine's cc-switch / ZCode config (backed up first).
keys.importHintDisabled: Local import is off. It writes keys into this machine's cc-switch / ZCode config, so it is disabled by default: set WB_LOCAL_IMPORT=1 in the panel's .env and restart.
keys.importHintRemote: You are not on the machine running this panel, so your local client cannot be written — use Export and import the snippet manually.
keys.importHintNotInstalled: No config for that client was found on this machine. Install it and start it once, or use Export.
keys.importHintDeeplink: Hands the config to cc-switch itself: it shows its own confirmation dialog — click Import there. It will not be closed and its database is left untouched.
keys.importHintWillClose: That client is running. Importing will close it for you, write the config, then reopen it — no need to quit and relaunch by hand.
keys.importHintRunning: That client is running and the panel could not locate its executable, so it cannot reopen it for you. Quit it manually first, or use Auto-detect to locate it.
keys.importHintUnknown: Could not determine whether that client is running; import is disabled to avoid corrupting the config. Use Export instead.
keys.detectMissingHint: Check whether it is installed, or use Export to import manually.
keys.importDeeplinkNote: Click Import in the cc-switch window and it takes effect there.
keys.importClientClosedOnly: Config written, but the client could not be reopened automatically — please open it yourself.
keys.upstreamHint: Once bound, this key only uses that upstream account pool; unbound = default upstream

upstreams.nameUrlRequired: Name and upstream URL are both required
upstreams.hint: A key bound to an upstream only uses that pool; unbound keys use the default upstream.
upstreams.fieldDirHint: The auths directory (absolute path) of this group's upstream instance. The accounts page lists, adds and moves accounts there; leave empty to use this group for key forwarding only.

upstreams.formGroupHint: One group = one upstream endpoint (its own address / api_key / account directory). A name is enough to create one: the other fields come pre-filled with defaults, change them as needed.

tasks.title: Task records
tasks.description: Check-in results, upstream automatic tasks and credit earnings for {realm} (auto-refresh every 30s)
tasks.runDesc: Runs the upstream task_runner.py. "Preview" only queries, sending nothing. "Claim rewards" collects rewards for tasks already completed (idempotent, fabricates nothing). "Complete tasks" lights up tasks and sends activity reports to Tencent, which carries some risk-control exposure.
tasks.runPreviewHint: Only queries current task status; sends no write requests
tasks.runClaimHint: Only collects rewards for completed tasks (idempotent, fabricates nothing)
tasks.runFullHint: Lights up tasks + claims rewards: sends activity reports, use with care
tasks.runFullConfirmBody: This sends **activity reports** to Tencent to light up tasks: creating canvases, repeated chats, bulk expert usage and more. Those actions are fabricated by a program and put the account at risk-control exposure — upstream itself marks this kind of bulk write as "use with care". Consider "Preview" first; if you only want rewards for work already done, use "Claim rewards" instead.
tasks.runLogWarnFallback: [warn] {what} fetch failed ({err}), falling back to the built-in table
tasks.runLogClaimFallback: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: claim {status} {msg} -> falling back to the web realm
tasks.runLogNotMapped: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: query not in the mapping table, skip
tasks.runLogNotMappedStatus: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: query {status} -> not in the mapping table, skip
tasks.runLogClaimedUnmapped: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: query claimed -> already claimed, skip (not in the mapping table)
tasks.runLogNightCatClosed: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: query in_progress({cur}/{target}) -> outside the night-cat window (23-08 CST), skip pending
tasks.runLogNightCatOpen: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: query in_progress({cur}/{target}) -> inside the night-cat window, one extra run allowed, dry run skipped
tasks.runLogLightUpDryRun: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: query {status}({cur}/{target}) -> light-up needed={need} id source={src} ids={ids}, dry run skipped
tasks.runLogBuddy5Fallback: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: report {i}/{need} {status} code={sc} buddy5 failed -> falling back to a single send {status2} code={sc2}
tasks.runLogNoObjectId: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: report no usable object id, skip
tasks.runLogNoObjectIdSkipLight: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: {kind} no usable object id, WARN skipping light-up
tasks.runLogIdsFewerThanNeeded: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: only {have} usable object ids < {need} needed, reporting what is available this run
tasks.runLogBelowTarget: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: report below target ({cur}/{target}), WARN for next run
tasks.runLogBulkWarning: WARN: full batch + --yes without --only — mind batch 54, confirm the Hermes decision before running
tasks.runLogGlobalSkip: [skip] {uid} global realm does not apply to CN tasks
tasks.runLogKilledIdle: !! no output for {idle}s, judged stalled and terminated
tasks.clearCheckinDescLocalAuto: This deletes {local} check-in records triggered here (manual / batch / add account). The {auto} upstream automatic check-ins are not deleted here — clear them under Auto tasks.
tasks.clearCheckinDesc: Only the local check-in history is deleted; accounts and upstream data are untouched.
tasks.checkinEmpty: No check-in records yet. Using Check in all on the Accounts page, or the 🎁 button of a single account, leaves a record here.
tasks.taskLogLoadFailed: Automatic task records failed to load
tasks.rawLogNote: Upstream only logs **failures** and **travel / activity**: successful check-ins and normal keep-alives are silent, so an empty list does not mean nothing ran. Structured records that survive container rebuilds are listed under Automatic tasks & credits below.
tasks.taskLogSubtitle: Cat travel / activity report / auto check-in / keep-alive / school season / night cat
tasks.collectNoneDetail: Upstream has not produced new automatic task logs yet
tasks.clearTasksDesc: Only records collected by this console are deleted; accounts and upstream keep running.
tasks.filterNoRecords: “{label}” has no records in the selected time range.
tasks.filterHint: Pick All above to see other types, or widen the time range.
tasks.globalNoTasks: The Global edition (workbuddy.ai) has **no check-in / cat travel / school season / night cat tasks** — upstream skips such accounts entirely and sends no request (to avoid risk control); credits come only from the one-off trial.
tasks.globalKeepalive: **Keep-alive and activity reporting still run**, and will show up here when there are records. Switch back to the China edition to see check-ins and travel.
tasks.noTaskRecords: No automatic task records yet. Upstream prints check-in / cat travel / activity / keep-alive results to the container log; the backend collects them every 45 seconds and keeps them long-term (container rebuilds do not lose them).
tasks.noTaskRecordsHint: Use Collect now in the top right to see results immediately.

tasks.runLogLightUpKindDryRun: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: query {status}({cur}/{target}) -> can light up ({kind}), dry-run skipped
tasks.runLogTaskLocked: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: query locked (unlocks {unlock}) -> not live yet, skipped
tasks.runLogMpTaskMissing: [task_runner] {uid} {code}: task not found in mp scope, skip
tasks.runLogSchoolNotInPeriod: [task_runner] {uid} school activity not in period (in_period=false); school section skipped

updatePanel.signedTitle: The release archive passed signature verification
updatePanel.signedTitleDetail: The release archive passed signature verification ({detail})
updatePanel.unsignedTitle: This update skipped signature verification (WB_SKIP_SIGNATURE=1); the archive was not validated
updatePanel.upToDateDesc: Neither the manager nor upstream has an update
updatePanel.allUpToDate: Manager and upstream are both up to date
updatePanel.viewCommits: See what changed in these {n} commits
updatePanel.changesTruncated: Only the latest {n} are shown; see the repository compare page for the full list
updatePanel.updateHint: Use the buttons below to update; accounts and configuration are preserved.
updatePanel.updatingHint: The service may restart briefly during the update (the page reconnects automatically) — do not shut down the server. Progress refreshes every 1.5 seconds.
updatePanel.doneRestart: The service restarted; refresh the page to confirm the version number.
updatePanel.doneSigned: This release archive passed signature verification.
updatePanel.failedDetail: Check the log below; accounts and configuration were not affected.
updatePanel.skippedWarn: This update **skipped signature verification** (WB_SKIP_SIGNATURE=1); the archive was not validated. Unless you are rotating signing keys, turn that switch off and update again.
updatePanel.updaterMissingHint: `deploy/update.py` must exist. If you are on an older install package, redeploy once with the new package.
updatePanel.oneClickUpdateDesc: The manager pulls its new version from GitHub; the upstream code is refreshed from the package (git deployments pull their remote), then both are rebuilt/restarted. Account credentials, upstream config, keys and logs are preserved.
updatePanel.targetBothHint: Upstream rebuilds its container (accounts and config preserved); the manager restarts its service
updatePanel.targetUpstreamHint: Fetch upstream code (from the package; git deployments pull their remote) → rebuild the container. Port binding is re-converged to localhost only
updatePanel.targetManagerHint: Download the latest release → replace code and frontend → restart the service
updatePanel.targetDescText: {desc}. {hint}. The service is briefly interrupted during the update; finished tasks are unaffected.
updatePanel.dockerBlocked: This environment cannot access docker, so upstream cannot be updated — run docker compose up -d --build on the host
updatePanel.dockerNote: This environment cannot access docker (docker is not installed on the host, or the container does not mount `/var/run/docker.sock`), so the upstream container cannot be rebuilt from the UI. Run `docker compose up -d --build` on the host. Mount the docker socket in container deployments to restore this feature (see `docker-compose.yml` in the repository).
updatePanel.pinDesc: For git-based upstream deployments the branch defaults to master. If one commit is itself broken (e.g. its Dockerfile references a deleted file and the rebuild fails), put a working **commit or tag** here and "Update upstream" will check that out instead of the latest code — a quick rollback. Clear and save to follow the branch again. Package-distributed upstreams have no git remote, so this does not apply there.
updatePanel.refPinnedDesc: The next Update upstream will check out {ref} instead of following the branch
updatePanel.refUnpinnedDesc: Upstream updates will follow the branch again
updatePanel.logEmpty: No log yet. Progress appears here in real time once an update starts.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Upstream proxy configuration, model alias mapping and console users
settings.reloadTitle: Re-read the upstream configuration and model list (upstream caches its own model list for 1 hour)
settings.cfgUnreadableHint: Make sure workbuddy2api is deployed and the path is correct (environment variable `WB_UPSTREAM_CONFIG`). Until it can be read, the settings below are locked so an empty configuration cannot overwrite the real file.
settings.authDirMismatch: The account directory declared in the upstream configuration differs from the one read here; this console uses the account directory shown above.
settings.modelsStaticTitle: When the live fetch fails, upstream falls back to its built-in static model table — a fixed list compiled into the binary, smaller than what is actually available. Use Refetch on the right to try again. This note can only appear with an older upstream (newer versions are purely dynamic and simply return an empty list).
settings.refetchModelsTitle: Fetch the model list from upstream again (upstream caches it for 1 hour)
settings.modelsNotFetched: No model list yet — check that the upstream container is running
settings.cfgNotReady: Configuration not ready, cannot fetch models
settings.modelsStaticNote: The live fetch failed, so the **static table compiled into the binary** is shown — fewer models than are actually available. Use Refetch to try again, or restart the upstream container and retry. (Newer upstream versions dropped that fallback table, so seeing this means the upstream is old.)
settings.modelsNote: The list is fetched by one healthy account chosen at random upstream, **so it depends on that account's authorization** — different accounts (enterprise / plan) may see different numbers of models. Upstream caches it for 1 hour.
settings.upstashDescOn: Session stickiness and account state are shared through Upstash, keeping multiple instances consistent
settings.upstashDescOff: Currently in-memory only (noop): state lives inside the container. That is normal for a single instance; configure Upstash when you scale out or want state to survive restarts
settings.upstashUrlHint: Copy the endpoint from the REST API section of the Upstash console
settings.upstashTokenHintSaved: The plaintext is never shown back for security; leaving it empty keeps the current value
settings.upstashTokenHint: Token that goes with the URL above
settings.upstashClearDesc: The Upstash URL and token will be cleared and upstream falls back to in-memory mode (noop). Upstream reloads automatically after saving.
settings.upstashFooter: Saving restarts upstream automatically so the change takes effect (about 0.5s; in-flight requests finish normally). Upstash connects when the container starts, so no manual restart is needed; if the configuration is wrong upstream degrades to noop with a warning and stays available.
settings.advancedDesc: Edit the raw JSON directly for parameters not covered above
settings.cfgNotLoaded: Upstream configuration not loaded; editing is disabled
settings.mapNewAliasDesc: Let downstream call a model by a name you already know. For example point `gpt-4o-mini` at `glm-5.2`.
settings.mapEmpty: No mappings yet; downstream can use the names from Available models above
settings.usersNewDesc: Administrators can add or remove accounts and change settings; read-only users can only look, which suits sharing status with colleagues.
settings.passwordRelogin: Your current session was revoked; sign in again with the new password
settings.passwordOthersRevoked: All other sessions of that user were revoked
settings.deleteUserDesc: That user will no longer be able to sign in to the console.
settings.usersEmptyDesc: Keep at least one administrator account
settings.aboutDesc: This project provides the web console and public API gateway for workbuddy2api (a Tencent CodeBuddy → OpenAI-compatible proxy). Account rotation, concurrency and breakers are handled by workbuddy2api; this console handles account onboarding, key distribution, IP control, request logs and usage statistics.
settings.aboutCredits: The interface style draws on linux-do/cdk (MIT) — with thanks.
settings.aboutUsage: Downstream setup: use `https://your-domain/v1` as the Base URL and a `wbk_...` key issued on the API keys page.
settings.savedManualStep: Settings saved, but one manual step is required
settings.jsonInvalid: Invalid JSON — check the braces and commas
settings.jsonNotObject: It must be a JSON object, for example { "checkin_hours": [9, 21] }
settings.errHourRange: “{v}” is not an hour between 0 and 23
settings.errNoNewline: Line breaks and control characters are not allowed
settings.errEnum: Value is outside the allowed range
settings.displayDesc: This group only affects how **this browser** shows things — no system behavior changes, and it takes effect immediately.
settings.expiryDailyDesc: When on, the dashboard groups them by **calendar day**: credits expiring on the same day are summed instead of showing only the nearest one. Hovering still lists the amount and date of every entry.
settings.tokensAdminRequiredDesc: Access tokens can call the admin API without signing in (including minting gateway keys and changing the account pool), so they are limited to administrators. Ask an admin to set your role to admin under Settings → Users.
settings.tokensNewDesc: A long-lived credential for scripts / CI. It only authorises the admin API, not model calls. The plaintext is shown once, on creation.
settings.tokensCreatedDesc: Copy it now: the plaintext is shown only once.
settings.tokensEmptyDesc: Create a token so scripts / CI can call the admin API without logging in
settings.tokensDeleteDesc: Scripts using this token stop working immediately (401). This cannot be undone.
settings.tokensSessionOnlyHint: High-risk endpoints (updating, clearing logs, user management) still require a session login; tokens cannot call them.
settings.resetPasswordDesc: All of this user's existing sessions will be revoked. At least 8 characters.

phrases.派出失败: Failed to send out on a trip
phrases.等待响应头超时: Timed out waiting for response headers
phrases.登录状态已失效，请重新登录: Your session has expired; please sign in again
phrases.失败次数过多，请 10 分钟后再试: Too many failed attempts; try again in 10 minutes
phrases.密码至少 8 位: Password must be at least 8 characters
phrases.不能删除当前登录用户: You cannot delete the user you are signed in as
phrases.key_id 必须是数字或 all: key_id must be a number or all
phrases.每天自动领取免费额度；签到时的余额查询还能解冻被冷却的账号: Claims the free daily allowance; the balance query during check-in also unfreezes cooled-down accounts
phrases.在哪些整点执行签到（0-23，可多个）。签到时同时刷新余额并解冻冷却账号: Hours at which check-in runs (0-23, multiple allowed). It also refreshes the balance and unfreezes cooled-down accounts
phrases.自动推进「猫猫旅行」：领养 / 派出 / 领取到站奖励，可获得积分: Advances Cat travel automatically: adopt / send out / claim arrival rewards, earning credits
phrases.在哪些整点推进旅行（0-23，可多个）。默认两趟闭环：早上领奖并派出，晚上领当日: Hours at which travel advances (0-23, multiple allowed). The default two-round loop claims and sends out in the morning, then claims the day's reward in the evening
phrases.每日上报一次对话活跃，点亮连续登录并解锁领养前置任务（领猫需要）: Reports conversation activity once a day, keeping the login streak and unlocking the prerequisite task for adopting a cat
phrases.在哪些整点上报（0-23，可多个）。每号每天一次即可，重复上报无额外收益: Hours at which the report is sent (0-23, multiple allowed). Once per account per day is enough; repeats give no extra benefit
phrases.定期刷新登录令牌，避免账号因长期闲置掉线: Refreshes login tokens periodically so idle accounts do not drop offline
phrases.在哪些整点刷新令牌（0-23，可多个）: Hours at which tokens are refreshed (0-23, multiple allowed)
phrases.自动完成开学季任务中心的活动并抽空抽奖余额（仅国内版；国际版由脚本内部跳过）: Completes the school-season task centre activities and spends the lottery balance (China edition only; skipped internally for the Global edition)
phrases.在哪些整点执行开学季任务（0-23，可多个）。活动未开启时会自动跳过，不算失败: Hours at which school-season tasks run (0-23, multiple allowed). Skipped automatically — not counted as a failure — when the event is not open
phrases.在夜猫窗口（23:00–08:00）补做一次夜猫任务；窗口外会自动跳过: Runs the night-cat task once inside the night window (23:00–08:00); skipped outside the window
phrases.在哪些整点尝试夜猫任务（0-23，可多个）。默认凌晨 1 点；窗口内每天最多补一: Hours at which the night-cat task is attempted (0-23, multiple allowed). Defaults to 01:00; at most once per day inside the window
phrases.每个账号每次活跃上报发几条。领养猫需要 5 次对话，默认 5 条一次刷满；填 1: How many activity events each account sends per run. Adopting a cat needs 5 conversations, so the default of 5 fills it in one go; set 1 for the old behaviour
phrases.被腾讯限流后，账号冷却多久。数值越大越保守（格式如 600s / 10m / 1: How long an account cools down after Tencent rate-limits it. Larger is more conservative (format: 600s / 10m / 1h)
phrases.连续触发限流会逐次延长冷却，这是延长后的封顶值（格式如 2h）: Repeated rate limits extend the cooldown step by step; this caps that value (format: 2h)
phrases.一个账号同时处理几个请求。调大能提高吞吐，但更容易触发腾讯限流（0 = 不限制）: How many requests one account handles at once. Raising it increases throughput but makes Tencent rate limits more likely (0 = unlimited)
phrases.某账号连续失败多少次后，自动暂停使用它一段时间: How many consecutive failures an account may hit before it is paused for a while
phrases.被熔断的账号先等待多久（格式如 30m / 1h）: How long a tripped account waits first (format: 30m / 1h)
phrases.反复熔断会指数退避延长，这是封顶值（格式如 6h）: Repeated trips extend the cooldown exponentially; this caps it (format: 6h)
phrases.账号每闲置 1 小时增加一点调度权重，让久未使用的账号优先被选中: Each idle hour adds a little scheduling weight so long-unused accounts are picked first
phrases.闲置加成的封顶值，避免某个账号权重无限增大: Caps the idle bonus so one account's weight cannot grow without bound
phrases.上游的选号优化：长时间只用高成本档位时，每隔这么久会改走一次低成本档位探测，成功: An upstream account-picking optimisation: when only a high-cost tier has been used for a while, it switches to a low-cost tier to probe once every this interval, and stays there if it succeeds (saving credits). Empty = upstream default 30m, 0 = disable this optimisation
phrases.到期时间落在此窗口内的积分会被标记为「快过期」，选号时优先消耗掉，避免白白过期。: Credits expiring inside this window are marked as expiring soon and consumed first when picking an account, so they are not wasted. Empty or 0 disables the optimisation
phrases.对发往上游的请求做轻量脱敏，降低被判定异常的概率。除非在排查问题，否则建议保持开: Lightly sanitises outbound requests to reduce the chance of being flagged as anomalous. Keep it on unless you are debugging
phrases.同一会话的连续请求尽量路由到同一账号，多轮对话更连贯（多实例部署时依赖 Redi: Consecutive requests in one session are routed to the same account where possible, keeping multi-turn chats coherent (relies on Redis with multiple instances)
phrases.一次会话多久没活动就解除绑定（格式如 30m / 1h）: How long a session may sit idle before the binding is released (format: 30m / 1h)
phrases.后台多久清理一次过期会话（格式如 5m / 10m）: How often expired sessions are cleaned up in the background (format: 5m / 10m)
phrases.passthrough：原样透传客户端传来的 system 消息；custom：: passthrough: forward the client's system message untouched; custom: replace it with the gateway's own prompt
phrases.默认 passthrough 会把下游的 system prompt 原样送给上: The default passthrough sends the downstream system prompt to upstream unchanged. If you rely on the gateway's own prompt to stabilise behaviour (or to avoid the system fingerprint being flagged), switch to custom.
phrases.在 custom 与 append 模式下生效。留空使用内置默认提示词: Applies in both custom and append modes. Empty uses the built-in default prompt
phrases.路径必须存在于上游容器内且可读；写错会导致上游启动失败、反代不可用。不确定就留空: The path must exist and be readable inside the upstream container; a wrong value makes upstream fail to start and the gateway unavailable. Leave it empty if unsure.
phrases.单个请求体最大体积，超过返回 413。反代网关也按此值限制入站请求，调大可容纳更: Largest single request body; anything above returns 413. The gateway applies the same limit to inbound requests, so raising it allows longer contexts
phrases.网关向腾讯发起请求时使用的客户端标识，留空用内置默认（已对齐官方 WorkBud: Client identity the gateway uses towards Tencent; empty uses the built-in default (aligned with the official WorkBuddy)
phrases.用量归属头（X-Product / X-IDE-Name / X-IDE-Typ: Value for the usage-attribution headers (X-Product / X-IDE-Name / X-IDE-Type / X-IDE-Version); it affects the client shown on the official site. Empty = match the official desktop client (WorkBuddy); SaaS restores the old behaviour
phrases.出站 UA 里 WorkBuddy/<版本> 这段，也用于 X-IDE-Vers: The WorkBuddy/<version> part of the outbound UA, also used for the X-IDE-Version header. Empty = built-in default (aligned with the official distribution)
phrases.出站 UA 里 CLI/<版本> 这段。留空 = 内置默认: The CLI/<version> part of the outbound UA. Empty = built-in default
phrases.宿主上存放 device token 的文件路径，留空则不读文件。上游每 5 分: Path to the device token file on the host; empty means no file is read. Upstream reads it every 5 minutes and ignores read failures
phrases.留空 = 不读文件: empty = do not read a file
phrases.是否把客户端 IP（X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP）透传: Whether to forward the client IP (X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP) upstream. Off by default, so internal or proxy IPs are not exposed to upstream
phrases.开启后，realm=global 的账号走 workbuddy.ai（国际版模型: When on, realm=global accounts use workbuddy.ai (Global models and endpoints). Turning it off locks the deployment to China only: Global accounts are then sent to the China endpoints as if they were China accounts, which is a misconfiguration
phrases.国际版的聊天 / 登录 / 模型接口基址，留空用内置默认 https://www: Base URL for Global chat / login / model endpoints; empty uses the built-in default https://www.workbuddy.ai
Base URL for Global credit / trial endpoints; empty uses the built-in default https://www.workbuddy.ai
phrases.六类任务各自独立排程：签到 / 猫猫旅行 / 活跃上报 / 保活 / 开学季 /: Six task families are scheduled independently: check-in / cat travel / activity report / keep-alive / school season / night cat. Each can be toggled and given its own hours. Check-in, travel, activity report, school season and night cat **apply to China-edition accounts only** — the Global edition has none of these, only keep-alive runs as usual
phrases.网关如何对待客户端传来的 system / developer 消息: How the gateway treats system / developer messages from clients
phrases.被腾讯限流后的冷却策略: Cooldown policy after Tencent rate-limits an account
phrases.多轮对话的路由粘性与清理策略: Routing stickiness and cleanup for multi-turn conversations
phrases.控制账号池的并发能力与故障保护: Concurrency and failure protection for the account pool
phrases.网关自身的请求约束: Request constraints applied by the gateway itself
phrases.网关向腾讯发起请求时的客户端标识: Client identity the gateway uses when calling Tencent
phrases.国际版（workbuddy.ai）路由开关与基址。关闭即锁死纯 CN: Routing switch and base URLs for the Global edition (workbuddy.ai). Turning it off locks the deployment to China only
phrases.国际版单独用这个上限。国际版的风控更严，官方默认压到 2——并发越高越容易被判为: The global edition uses this limit separately. It is subject to stricter anti-abuse checks and officially defaults to 2 — higher concurrency is more likely to be flagged as abnormal traffic. Setting 0 means "use the default 2" (note this differs from the "0 = unlimited" above).
phrases.passthrough：原样透传客户端传来的 system 消息；custom：: passthrough: client system messages pass through unchanged; custom: the gateway replaces them with its own prompt; append: both — the gateway system is inserted after the leading system/developer blocks, leaving existing messages untouched
phrases.默认 passthrough 会把下游的 system prompt 原样送给上: The default passthrough sends the downstream system prompt upstream as-is. Switch to custom if you rely on the gateway prompt to stabilise behaviour (or to avoid the system fingerprint being flagged); use append when you want to keep the client system message and have the gateway prompt take effect too.
phrases.append（保留客户端 system，其后插入网关提示词）: append (keep client system, insert gateway prompt after it)
phrases.国际版无签到体系，已跳过: The Global edition has no check-in system; skipped
phrases.该账号无有效 accessToken: This account has no valid accessToken
phrases.领奖跳过：已到站但无记录 ID: Claim skipped: arrived but no record ID
phrases.领养跳过：对话数未达门槛，明天重试: Adoption skipped: conversation threshold not reached, retrying tomorrow
phrases.连续天数校验失败（上报本身成功）: Streak check failed (the report itself succeeded)
phrases.上报成功但连续天数仍为 0（疑似被静默丢弃）: Report succeeded but the streak is still 0 (possibly silently dropped)
phrases.抽奖跳过：无次数或未开启: Lottery skipped: no chances left or not enabled
phrases.计划任务未执行: The scheduled task did not run
phrases.账号页的「临时停用」走哪条路。**开启后**上游提供停用接口：停用只摘除转发流量: Which path the "pause" action on the Accounts page takes. **When enabled**, the upstream exposes pause endpoints: pausing only removes the account from traffic, while check-in and token keep-alive keep running (credits and credentials stay alive). When disabled, pausing falls back to renaming the file, which removes the account from the pool entirely and stops its tasks too. **Restart the upstream container** for a change to take effect (the upstream only reads this flag at startup).
phrases.仅对**旧版**上游生效：上游 9d1a21b 起已移除该配置、不再限制请求体大: Applies to **older** upstream versions only: the upstream removed this setting in 9d1a21b and no longer limits request body size. This gateway's own inbound limit is controlled by the WB_GATEWAY_MAX_BODY_MB environment variable (default 32 MB)
phrases.让「临时停用」只摘除转发流量（签到 / 保活照常、积分与凭证保持活跃）。不开启时: Makes "pause" remove the account from traffic only (check-in / keep-alive keep running, credits and credentials stay alive). When off, pausing falls back to renaming the file — the account leaves the pool entirely and its tasks stop. **Requires restarting the upstream container**; the upstream also requires a non-empty api_key, otherwise it refuses to start.
phrases.刷新积分需要管理员权限: Refreshing credits requires an administrator account
phrases.本机导入未启用。它会把密钥直接写进本机的 cc-switch / ZCode 配: Local import is disabled. It writes the key straight into this machine's cc-switch / ZCode config, so it is off by default: set WB_LOCAL_IMPORT=1 in the panel's .env and restart the panel.
phrases.本机导入只允许从面板所在的机器访问（请用 http://127.0.0.1:<面: Local import is only allowed from the machine running the panel (open the panel at http://127.0.0.1:<panel port>). For remote deployments, use “Export config” and import manually — writing cc-switch / ZCode config on the server has no effect on your own machine.
phrases.该接口不接受 API Token，请用会话登录后操作: This endpoint does not accept API Tokens — sign in with a browser session to use it
